tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Participate in campus and community events and respond to participants

tasks.design: The teacher participates directly in campus and community events. Existing invitations in {CALENDAR} can support attendance but do not replace the participation being counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task depends on presence and responsive conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated change removes that work.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to unexpected questions and representing the institution responsibly.
tasks.human_edge: Personal connection and technically grounded responses.
tasks.altitude: The teacher's participation and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Contribute an engineering demonstration to an outreach event
reach.learn: Audience access needs and safe public demonstrations

evidence.claim: Presence and responsive discussion remain substantive work in event participation; no labour saving is asserted.

assumptions: Boundary is the engineering teacher's participation, not an event coordinator's invitations, catering or registration.
Event organisers provide the existing event purpose and participants produce questions during the event. No structured feed or new capture work is required.
Test existing calendar configuration if attendance administration becomes a separate problem; no custom build is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no changed process or software is introduced.
unknowns: Whether separate event administration is assigned to this role
research_questions: How much recorded event time is direct participation rather than separately assigned administration?

already_counted.description: Participation and responsive conversation remain fully counted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving 0. Direct participation remains unchanged even where invitations already use a calendar.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Act as advisers to student organizations through discussion and practical guidance

tasks.design: The teacher remains available for student organisation advice and discusses proposed activities directly. Policies held in {DOCS} remain references rather than a substitute for the advisory relationship.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student concerns and organisational context vary between conversations.
tasks.enabler_now: Reference access may already be digital; no additional saving is established.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing student initiative, safety and institutional expectations.
tasks.human_edge: Trust and judgement about the students' actual situation.
tasks.altitude: The teacher remains an adviser without gaining the student organisation's decision rights.

reach.task: Recognise a concern requiring specialist student support
reach.learn: Referral routes and limits of an academic advisory role

evidence.claim: Student organisation advice involves contextual discussion that is not removed by access to policy documents.

assumptions: Boundary is advisory discussion, not organisation bookkeeping, membership records or event production.
Student representatives produce concerns and proposed activities before or during s1; the teacher's clarification time is included in s1. No structured input is assumed.
Use existing document search before commissioning any separate policy lookup tool.
Zero incremental upkeep because the advisory process remains unchanged.
research_questions: Which repeated factual questions, if any, consume material advisory time rather than relationship work?

already_counted.description: All contextual advice and clarification remain counted

incremental.description: No new system or rules to maintain

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving 0. The scenario retains direct student organisation advice without inventing a preparation baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Agree consulting scope, constraints and available evidence with the client
Analyse engineering evidence and determine defensible recommendations
Draft consulting report from checked findings and recommendation notes

loop.purpose: Express the teacher's conclusions clearly without doing the engineering analysis
loop.input: Consulting scope, checked engineering findings and recommendation notes
loop.output: Draft report with each substantive assertion linked to a supplied finding
loop.check: Teacher checks recommendations, units, assumptions, limitations and causal statements against their own analysis
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported statements or prohibited client data return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: A native report template should be used first, but varied explanatory prose may require a bounded drafting loop

steps.what: Verify final report and provide professional consulting advice to the client

tasks.design: Keep scoping, engineering analysis and client advice with the teacher. A bounded loop in {DOCS} drafts prose from checked findings; the teacher verifies and releases the exact report before discussing its implications.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning technical findings into a readable report takes time, but generating plausible technical prose is unsafe without source checking.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting from a supplied evidence pack is plausible, subject to client permissions and local evaluation.
tasks.still_hard: Engineering validity, incomplete evidence, professional liability and client confidentiality.
tasks.human_edge: Taking responsibility for the analysis and explaining what the client can reasonably conclude.
tasks.altitude: A small amount of report composition may fall away; technical judgement and client responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Translate a reviewed engineering recommendation into project acceptance criteria
reach.learn: Delivery constraints, measurable acceptance and change control

evidence.claim: Drafting explanatory prose from teacher-checked findings is a plausible bounded use; engineering validity and time savings remain unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is this teacher's consulting service, excluding client implementation, laboratory work by other roles and institutional contract approval.

The client supplies existing problem evidence before s1; the teacher clarifies limitations in s1 and produces checked findings, calculations, units, assumptions and recommendation notes in s2. Preparation of the model input and correction are included in s3's retained time.
No structured engineering conclusions or safe disclosure permission are assumed to arrive automatically. Missing or restricted material requires manual report writing.
Test existing document templates and approved drafting configuration before custom integration.
Incremental allowance is 4 focal hours per 100 baseline for prompt maintenance, confidentiality checks and sampled comparison with manual reports; client analysis and discussion are not transferred.
unknowns: Client permission for processing consulting material
research_questions: Does checked-source drafting save time after unit, assumption and recommendation verification on representative reports?

already_counted.description: Draft input preparation and correction remain in s3
Final technical review, release and client advice remain in s4

incremental.description: Maintain drafting instructions, disclosure checks and sample evaluations

approvals.approved_version: Exact final consulting report version, client recipient and delivery copy; any changed assertion, attachment or recipient voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94.75; gross saving 5.25, less 4 upkeep gives net 1.25. Range 0-1 assumes a small prose-writing component, full engineering review and manual handling of restricted or poorly supported reports.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Search catalogues and source collections for specialized reading materials
Read and select suitable specialized materials for outside reading assignments
Capture and verify bibliographic metadata and source access for selected materials
Format bibliographies from verified records in the selected citation style

tasks.design: Use an existing reference manager, represented by {OTHER}, to format the teacher's verified source records into a bibliography in {DOCS}. The teacher still finds, reads and selects the materials and checks their metadata; no model invents references or decides suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manually arranging consistent citation details repeats rules that reference software can apply.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reference managers can generate citations from checked records without a custom model.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting technically sound readings at the right level and establishing accessible editions.
tasks.human_edge: Judging engineering relevance, pedagogical sequence and the limits of each source.
tasks.altitude: The teacher spends less time arranging citations; the teacher still owns reading choices rather than delegating academic selection.

reach.task: Maintain a course reading collection with verified editions and access notes
reach.learn: Catalogue identifiers, licensing boundaries and metadata quality

evidence.claim: Reference managers can format bibliographies deterministically from supplied bibliographic records; the proposed savings depend on a current manual formatting baseline.
The digest reports that fabricated references can pass plagiarism checks, supporting direct source verification rather than treating a generated citation as evidence.

assumptions: Boundary starts with course topics from existing course planning and ends with a bibliography draft. Publication of assignments and reading instruction are outside this task.

OTHER means a library catalogue and reference manager. The teacher produces candidate sources in s1 and selected materials in s2. In s3 the teacher captures and checks author, title, year, edition, journal or publisher, volume, pages, DOI or catalogue identifier, access link, reading order and citation style against the actual source; all capture time is counted.
If metadata cannot be resolved or imported, the teacher enters it manually in s3 or formats that reference manually. The range allows such exceptions; no perfect structured catalogue feed is assumed.
Use native reference-manager formatting before custom code. Existing automatic bibliography generation earns no saving; this scenario requires manual formatting today.
Incremental upkeep is 5 focal hours per 100 baseline for style changes, export faults and bibliography spot checks. Academic selection is not transferred to a librarian or model.
unknowns: Current use of native citation formatting
Share of incomplete metadata and inaccessible editions
research_questions: Does native formatting reduce hands-on time after metadata capture, broken-link checks and output correction?

already_counted.description: Academic reading and selection remain fully counted
Metadata capture, source checks and manual import exceptions remain counted

incremental.description: Maintain citation style and handle export faults and output spot checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross saving 20 less 5 upkeep gives net 15. Range 2-10 assumes manual formatting today, with incomplete metadata, edition verification and occasional manual citations reducing realised returns; already configured native formatting yields zero additional saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Engineering judgement, student relationships and public engagement remain central; selected report prose and citation formatting may take less time.
reach: Contribute reviewed technical acceptance criteria to project planning
Maintain verified reading collections with a subject librarian
skills_to_grow: Checking generated technical prose against calculations and limitations
role.ambitious_version: Use modest administrative capacity to improve the quality of technical explanations and reading access while retaining personal responsibility for advice.
